$comment: Powers (spec pass S1 draft, 2026-11-02; docs/design/spec-s1-water.md section 8). DRAFT: not loaded yet; the implementer moves it to data/rules/ with a schema. Integers only. Units: mm, um/s (micrometres of water depth per second), ticks at 20 per second. The range rule distance is settled (brief 2026-10-08); every other number is a proposal for the user to confirm, hence status placeholder. Energy cost is deliberately absent: spec pass S5 sets prices.

powers.$comment: Palette: wide, slow; raises wetness and feeds rivers over time. Rain writes only water; the soil takes its share as wetness (fields.json water_to_wetness), so there is one source of truth. Rate tuned against the M3 flood test (spec section 13), allowed tuning band 2000-5000 um/s.

area.$comment: Circle with a player-chosen radius (decision D2). Must lie wholly inside the map, else refused while planning.

rangeRule.$comment: Brief 2026-10-08: whole area at least 100 m from both armies' regiment outlines at the firing tick, else fizzle. checkAt castTick = the queued tick, when the wind-up begins (decision D1). Outline: coarse 4.5 m cells holding at least minSoldiersPerCoarseCell soldiers of the regiment, swept soldiers included (decision D9).

writes.$comment: Uniform over the area for durationTicks after the wind-up, applied at each field step from one per-cast remainder accumulator. Overlapping rains add.
